lens: Geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then lighting on the seats, then artefacts. Measured against ANA y_47300-07 (colour and finish) and the in-service photos sans 13/15/20/23 and fr57325 124234 (geometry). Extra studio renders are in /tmp/claude-0/raterB7/r (f_level, f_302, b_sans15, h_side, a_303, hk_hood); crops and comparisons are in /tmp/claude-0/raterB7/*.png; stats.py there gives the mean hex, L50, p90/p50, G/B and Otsu light area / hi-lo.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-1 (high): back top z-fight, with a fabric band and side bulges above the hood
priorIssues.evidence: x_backtop shows a clean shell cap with a thin navy rim and no streaks. In the q17 foreground the rim is about 0.07 of the hood width, against about 0.09 in y_47303 and a thin rim in fr57325 124234.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-2 / w6b-1 (high): diamond fabric pale-dominant, figure and ground inverted
priorIssues.evidence: q15 seat 1: Otsu light 0.25, hi/lo 1.65. Photos: y_47306 left seat 0.20 / 1.98, y_47302 middle seat 0.37 / 1.74. The pale diamonds now sit on navy. New problem: the motifs are too small and too regular (issue w7b-3).

priorIssues.issue: w6a-3 / w6b-3: screen bezel fills too much of the hood
priorIssues.evidence: q18: bezel about 414 px of a 494 px hood face = 0.84. y_47305 0.86, sans 15 0.87. The hood face is flat with tight corners.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-4 / w6b-2: footrest hangers read as a chain of beads
priorIssues.evidence: e8_foot and e6_lowback show smooth flat bowed bars with a grey joint. The bars are slightly narrower than the about 0.05 m arm in y_47304 (cosmetic).

priorIssues.issue: w6a-5: mosaic fabric reads as blobby camouflage, not a dash checker
priorIssues.evidence: tex_y_mosaic.png is now built from horizontal dashes. At row distance, q15 seat 2 still reads as irregular light blobs about 4-5 cm across (mos2.png); y_47302 left seat at the same pixel scale shows a fine, regular basket checker. The colour has also gone wrong: q15 #1e2a62, L50 41, G/B 0.43, against y_47306 right seat #384776 G/B 0.60 and y_47302 left seat #5771ad G/B 0.65 (issue w7b-2).

priorIssues.issue: w6a-6 / w6b-4: headrest cushion does not read as a separate pad
priorIssues.evidence: f_level and q15: the 0.255 cover covers almost the whole visible pad. The pad's wings show as slivers of 0-15 px and do not stand forward of the cover. y_47306, y_47302 and sans 13 show round wing bolsters projecting 3-5 cm ahead of the cover, a pad spanning 0.9-0.96 of the back, and (y_47300) a lighter wing fabric: wing L 113 against back 52-91.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-7 / w6b-6: petal flecks were comma-shaped and clumped
priorIssues.evidence: h_side and e7: petals now spread evenly at blue-noise spacing; a few are still teardrop-shaped. q15 seat 4: Otsu light 0.17, hi/lo 2.21, against y_47300 seat 2 0.16 / 2.36 (match). The ground is still a little dark and purple: L50 40, G/B 0.52, against L50 52, G/B 0.59.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-8: headrest cover too dark and blue
priorIssues.evidence: q15 cover #272f54, G/B 0.56, L50 49, against y_47300 #3d425e, G/B 0.70, L50 67. q16 cover #283158, G/B 0.56. In y_47306, y_47302 and y_47301 the covers measure G/B 0.68-0.75 (#475273, #505673, #3b405f). The render still reads as navy-blue plastic, not slate leatherette.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-9 / w6b-9: pocket net opaque; tray placard blank
priorIssues.evidence: e5 and b_sans15 now show the pictogram block at the tray's left. e6: the net is still a uniform dark slab running across, where sans 20 shows a see-through black mesh in two bulging pouches split by a central strap, with a ruched elastic top.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-10: pillow outline has straight edges
priorIssues.evidence: f_level, e4 and a_303 show rounded-rectangle cushions with a straight top edge. y_47300 shows all four pillows bow-tie shaped, with concave sides and pinched corners.

priorIssues.issue: w6b-7: pillow too narrow, too light, too rigid
priorIssues.evidence: f_level pillow 116 px at a 152 px seat pitch = 0.76; y_47300 116 / 154 = 0.75. Height 0.49 against 0.48 of the pitch. q15 #232b52, L50 46, against y_47300 #252c4c, L50 50.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-11: missing round coat-hook knob on the hood side
priorIssues.evidence: hk_hood and x_backtop show no knob. sans 15 (x 190 and 1015, y 200) and fr57325 124234 (x 296, y 548) show an off-white knob about 0.03 m across at the hood's upper outer corner.

priorIssues.issue: w6b-5: belts too light and cyan
priorIssues.evidence: f_level webbing mean (65,106,179), G/B 0.59. y_47303 (67,124,191), (72,118,193), (89,147,201): G/B 0.61-0.73. If anything the render is now slightly less teal than y_47303.

priorIssues.issue: w6b-8: back-top band from behind about 2x the photo
priorIssues.evidence: See w6a-1. From above (q17) the cover's top fold now shows as a navy bar behind each hood (issue w7b-8).

priorIssues.issue: w6b-10: triplanar smear on 45-degree faces (lighting owner)
priorIssues.evidence: b_sans15 left seat side and q16 seat-back sides still show diagonal smeared streaks.

priorIssues.issue: w6b-11: q15 camera does not match y_47300 (QA harness)
priorIssues.evidence: q15 still looks down about 24 degrees, which hides the pans and makes the covers dominate. q16 and q17 viewpoints also differ from y_47301 and y_47303.

details.refs: q15 seat 3: L50 57, light 0.43, hi/lo 2.13. y_47300 seat 1: L50 89, light 0.51, hi/lo 2.02. Pattern and contrast match; the tick-to-fleck brightness ratio is 1.43 against 1.71 in the photo.
h_side, q15 seat 4 (stats match y_47300 seat 2). The ground is slightly purple: G/B 0.52 against 0.59.

The light/dark balance is now right, but the motifs are a regular wallpaper grid of identical small crosses about 0.05 m across. y_47302 and y_47306 show 0.07-0.11 m stepped diamonds in irregular stacked clusters on a mottled ground (mosaic_cmp.png, d302.png).

mos2.png and mosaic_cmp.png: blobby at row distance, darker than the other fabrics and too purple (G/B 0.43). In the photos the mosaic is as light as or lighter than the other fabrics (y_47302 L50 110 against diamond 72).

The seat-by-seat mix is right. But in y_47300 the pans do not follow the backs: fleck backs sit on tick and mosaic pans, and a tick back sits on a diamond pan (pans.png). The model always pairs a pan with its own back, except diamond backs, which get tick pans.

f_level, q15, h_side against y_47300, y_47306, y_47302 and sans 13. The pad wings are not visible as bolsters. The cover is too navy and blue (G/B 0.56 against 0.68-0.75), and it reads as a rigid box with visible thickness in h_side.
Size and colour now match y_47300. The bow-tie pinch is missing.

e7 and a_303: a straight box beam on a vertical cylindrical post with a knuckle. In y_47300 and y_47303 the beam is longer, tapered and gently curved, with a rounded nose and a sloping, blade-like front support. The colour is right: a_303 #bdc0cb against y_47303 #b4b7be-#bcc0c8.
The colour matches y_47303 (see priorIssues). y_47302 shows charcoal webbing (open question).
f_level and e1 show a good front roll and proportions. See the fabric-mix note above.

details.detail: Rear shell, hood and back top
details.refs: x_backtop and b_sans15 against sans 15 and fr57325 124234. The flat hood, the tight corners and the thin rim now match. The coat hook is missing.

q18 and e5 against y_47305 and sans 15. Bezel ratio 0.84 against 0.86. The handset well is a little small: 0.34 of the hood width against 0.41 in sans 15. The tray latch is 0.09 of the hood width against 0.14.
e6 and b_sans15 against sans 15 and sans 20. The purple safety card, the cup recess, the pictograms and the handset placard are all present. The net is opaque.
e8 against y_47304 and sans 23. Smooth bowed bars, the SEB box and the red life-vest tabs are present (as in y_47302).
q15 and q16 back rows: clean silhouettes, no popping visible. The covers are uniformly dark navy where the photos show slate.

issues.title: Headrest pad is invisible: no wing bolsters, so the cover reads as a dark slab on the back
issues.evidence: f_level: cover 82 px, and the pad wings show only as 0-15 px slivers that do not stand forward of the cover. In y_47306 and y_47302 the pad spans 0.90-0.96 of the back width. In sans 13 and y_47306 the round wing bolsters project an estimated 3-5 cm ahead of the cover, which sits recessed between them. In y_47300 the pad fabric is lighter than the back (wing L 113 against back 52-91). In 09a_econ.js the pad loft is 0.355 wide with a 0.046 corner radius, its front is flat at z -0.102, and the cover plate sits at -0.1005, only about 1 mm proud of the pad face.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat: widen the pad loft to 0.40 (SEC widths 0.36 / 0.395 / 0.40 / 0.395 / 0.37 / 0.32). Add two wing bolsters at x = ±0.165, about 0.075 w × 0.19 h × 0.12 d (gSuperellipsoid, or gRBox with r 0.035), centred at local z -0.075, so their fronts reach about -0.135, roughly 3 cm ahead of the cover. Recess the cover plate to z -0.096 between them, keeping the 0.255 width. Lighten the pad fabric in SEATMAT (09_seats.js yHead photoBase '#4d5479' -> about '#5d6994'), and give the fleck-back seats a lighter pad (HF = yHead, not F). Keep the 5 mm undercut shadow at the pad foot. Apply the same to the far-LOD box at line 238.

issues.title: Dash mosaic fabric too dark and purple, and blobby at row distance
issues.evidence: q15 seat 2: #1e2a62, L50 41, G/B 0.43, against diamond L50 61 and tick L50 57 in the same frame. Photos: y_47306 right seat #384776 (G/B 0.60, as dark as its neighbours) and y_47302 left seat #5771ad (L50 110, lighter than the diamond seat at 72). The tile's dash clusters are noise-shaped, so after minification they read as 4-5 cm clouds; y_47302 shows a regular basket checker of cells about 2-3 cm across (mos2.png).
issues.fix: 09_seats.js yFabricC: photoBase '#3e4a7a' -> about '#4a5a8a' (more green), targeting a rendered G/B of about 0.60 and L close to the tick fabric. Check PHOTO_ENC / LAYER_PARAMS[26] in 03_tex.js for chroma push. In test/make_swatches.py y_mosaic: replace the noise-thresholded dense/sparse mask with a rectangular cell grid (about 25 × 18 mm cells, alternate dense/sparse in a checker with about 20 % random swaps), keep the 6-12 × 1-1.5 mm dashes, and reduce tile repeat so that one cell is about 2 cm on the seat.

issues.title: Diamond motifs too small and too regular (wallpaper grid)
issues.evidence: q15 seat 1 and e4: identical plus-shaped diamonds about 0.05 m across on a strict lattice. y_47306 left seat: stepped diamonds 0.10-0.12 m across that merge into a lattice. y_47302 middle seat: 0.07 m diamonds in irregular stacked clusters and chevrons on a mottled grey-navy ground with low contrast. sans 13 (window seat): the same large, soft motifs.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_diamond: scale the motif about 1.6× (outer size about 75-90 mm including the steps). Place motifs on the lattice with about 30 % random omission and occasional 2-3 diamond vertical stacks, add a low-frequency mottle (±8 % luminance, 30-50 mm scale) to the ground, and keep the Otsu light area at 0.18-0.30 with hi/lo about 1.8.

issues.title: Headrest cover still navy-blue, not slate-grey leatherette
issues.evidence: Cover G/B: q15 0.56 and q16 0.56, against y_47300 0.70, y_47306 0.71, y_47302 0.75 and y_47301 0.68. L50: q15 49 against y_47300 67. In y_47306, y_47302 and y_47303 the covers read as distinctly greyer than the blue fabric.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js yCover: '#3b4260' -> about '#474c5e' (G/B ≈ 0.80 in base so that it renders about 0.70), with r 0.38 -> 0.45 for a satin sheen. Re-measure q15 cover against y_47300 #3d425e.

issues.title: Seat-pan fabric always follows the back; the real cabin mixes them
issues.evidence: y_47300 pans (pans.png): seat 1 tick back with tick pan; seat 2 fleck back with tick pan; seat 3 tick back with diamond pan; seat 4 fleck back with mosaic pan. In 09a_econ.js, PF equals F except for diamond backs.
issues.fix: In econSeat, take opts.panFab. In buildSeats or econUnit, pick it from an independent hash, for example econFab(k, n, 2) restricted to tick / mosaic / diamond with about 50 % tick. Keep fleck mostly on backs.

issues.title: Pillow lacks the bow-tie pinch
issues.evidence: f_level and a_303 show rounded rectangles. y_47300 (all four pillows) shows concave edges and pinched, slightly flared corners.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js pillow (lines 62-75): pull each corner vertex out by about 1.5 cm, pull the mid-edges in by about 1 cm (an n=4 superellipse with concave sides), and thin the rim to a 3 mm seam ridge.

issues.title: Armrest is a straight box on a cylinder post
issues.evidence: e7 and a_303 against y_47300, y_47302 and y_47303: the real armrest is a long, slightly curved beam tapering to a rounded nose, with a sloping blade-like front support. The model reads as a generic box with a knuckle.
issues.fix: In the armrest code in 09a_econ.js, loft the beam with a 1-1.5 cm downward camber and taper the height from 0.06 to 0.045 towards the nose. Replace the vertical cylinder with a flat blade about 0.035 × 0.015, sloped about 15 degrees forward.

issues.title: Cover reads as a rigid box with thick edges; top fold sticks up as a navy bar behind the hood
issues.evidence: h_side: a sharp-edged plate with visible thickness and a crease line. q17 foreground: the 0.046-deep top fold box shows as a solid navy bar behind each hood.
issues.fix: Replace the fold gRBox (0.255 × 0.016 × 0.046) with a quarter-cylinder strip of radius about 0.02 that follows the pad top. Thin the plate edge (r 0.006 -> 0.0025), and drop the fold 5 mm so that it sits below the shell cap from behind.

issues.title: Pocket net opaque; coat-hook knob missing
issues.evidence: e6 against sans 20 (see-through mesh, two pouches, central strap). sans 15 and fr57325 124234 show the hood knob.
issues.fix: Net: use an alpha-tested mesh material, or a cut grid of thin bars over a darker inset, plus a 0.02-wide central strap and a 0.012 ruched elastic band at the top. Hook: a gSuperellipsoid about 0.028 across and 0.012 proud on each outer hood side at local y about 0.80, in yShell.

issues.title: QA harness views do not match references (q15 pitch, q16/q17 position) - harness owner
issues.evidence: q15 looks down about 24 degrees, where y_47300 is near level. q16 is taken from the aisle, where y_47301 is taken from the left window side. q17 is taken from above and aft, where y_47303 is a side view over the seats.
issues.fix: test/qa.js: q15 pitch to about -0.12 at eye height 1.35. q16 eye at about x -2.0, low and near the window, looking aft and right. q17 should match y_47303: look outboard across a 3-seat block from the aisle.

questionsForUser: Seat belts: y_47303 shows teal-blue webbing but y_47302 shows charcoal. Are there two webbing colours in service (for example by row or by retrofit batch), or is one photo colour-shifted?
Headrest covers range from about 0.21 m wide (y_47300) to about 0.30 m (y_47306, where the flap carries the ANA mark). Are there two cover sizes, or are the y_47306 covers a different (newer) part?
Seat pans: y_47300 suggests pan fabrics are mixed independently of the backs (for example a fleck back on a mosaic pan). Can you confirm from your own flight photos?
extraRefsSearched: No new photos downloaded. The existing ref/web/econ set (sans 13/15/20/23, fr57325 124234) and ref/ana y_47300-07 covered every question in this round.
